latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Downloader — Download and Save Videos Locally.

- Instantly download YouTube and online videos by sharing URLs, with results returned as 1080p MP4 files.
- No software install needed; simply paste URLs and describe the format you want.
- Automatic handling of anonymous token generation and session setup on first use.
- Supports multiple export formats: mp4, mov, avi, webm, mkv, jpg, png, gif, webp, mp3, wav, m4a, aac.
- Batch upload and edit workflows supported; each video processed individually with quick 20–40 second turnaround for typical clips.
- Error handling for token expiry, out-of-credits, format limits, and backend status updates.
